summary: Google signs a 20-year deal for 890 MW of new capacity from uprates at 11 Constellation nuclear units in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey, the first due by 2028. No value stated.
notes: Constellation says the deal enables more than $4.3B of its own investment in the uprates; that is not the contract value, so no amount is stored. The 15-year, 2,700 MW supply agreement signed alongside it is a separate edge. A five-year Google Cloud technology alliance announced the same day states no amount or direction and is not stored.
